column29: Official India launch release specifies 326 hp, 0–100 km/h in 6.1 s, 76.6 kWh battery, range up to 425 km and 11 kW AC charging. Torque and DC maximum are not stated.

reviewer_notes: Official India launch release specifies 385 kW / 523 hp, 765 Nm, 111.5 kWh gross battery, 635 km WLTP range, 195 kW DC and up to 22 kW AC charging. Current orderability is not established.
